Decoder translation comparisons

Compare each decoder's English with the reference-assisted translation of the same public message. The overview preserves every completed cell and the failed attempt; the message table lets you inspect what lies behind each mean.

Text similarity, not accuracy. MiniLM cosine measures resemblance between English texts. It can miss incorrect numbers, negation, roles, or actions. References retain uncertainty and are not certified ground truth.

Missing and wholly unknown decoder answers receive zero on scorable references. Partial unknown answers remain scored. Task status and discarded messages are excluded. High-confidence means cover only the reference subset shown.
